_about: Size records fragment (List 17 #161) — SHAPE ONLY, instanced NOWHERE, by necessity: height/weight are TBD for all 49 Gen 1 species (species-data audit) and no measurement number exists in canon data. The record derives from append-only measurement facts (the #97 stored-fact class); measure is null shape-wide until the data lane closes the measurement TBD. Any version of this file carrying numbers would be inventing them.

contest.hostsSchedulesRewards: all OPEN (rewards in #20 data grammar; an occasion for a #104 stamp — stamps stay #104's vocabulary)

open_register: the measurement derivation (base x variance) — the system's single dependency
whether a sighting/estimate fact class should exist — not proposed
every contest: hosts, schedules, entry rules, prizes
